title: RESUME
text:
EDUCATION
Masters in Geomatics for Ecosystem Management (MGEM)
Professional Masters, Faculty of Forestry, University of British Columbia (UBC)
B.A. Major in Geography: Environment and Sustainability
Minor in Geographic Information Science (GIS) and Geographic Computation
Bachelor of Arts, Department of Geography, University of British Columbia


EMPLOYMENT
GIS Technologist, Contractor, Tobique (Neqotkuk) First Nation, New Brunswick
Development of data directory and webmaps for geospatial and remote sensing data.
Jan 2026 - Present
Student Assistant for Dr. Pasang Yangjee Sherpa, Ph.D, Institute for Critical Indigenous Studies, UBC
Digitization of analog sources and database construction. Development of content and graphics for ArcGIS StoryMap project. Review and formatting of articles for alignment with publisher guidelines and citation styles (eg. MLA, APA, Chicago).
Oct 2024 - April 2025


EXPERIENCE
Student, Haida Gwaii Summer Semester on Plants, People, and Place
Intensive in Haida ways of being and knowing related to systems thinking, governance and management, field ecology, and ethnobotany.
May - June 2025
Editor for Volume 18 of UBC’s Trail Six Undergraduate Journal of Geography
Review of journal submissions, collaboration with authors, and liasoning with faculty supervisors. Edits for clarity, substance, and style.
Oct 2023 - April 2024
Notetaker, Department of Geography, UBC
GEOS 406: Watershed Geomorphology (Winter Term 1, 2024).
GEOG 313: Environmental Justice and Social Change (Winter Term 2, 2025)
Detailed documentation of lecture content and course announcements.
